Question Choices: For 20x ≡ 30 (mod 70), find the least positive integer solution.
Hints: Divide the coefficient, right-hand side, and modulus by their GCD before solving.
Solution: gcd(20,70) = 10. Divide by 10: 2x ≡ 3 (mod 7). Inverting 2 modulo 7 gives x ≡ 5 (mod 7). The requested solution is 5.
